label: Bible Study
prompt: For, lo, the _____ is past, the rain is over and gone;
verse: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
note: The next line in the beloved's call — winter's over, the rain is gone, and the flowers are up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For I will pour water upon him that is _____, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
verse: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
note: Water for the thirsty, and God's spirit poured out on your children — a promise for the next generation.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the _____ that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:
verse: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:
note: Haman designed a royal parade thinking it was for himself — robe, crown, and the king's own horse. It was for Mordecai.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Is it _____ to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
verse: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
note: Jerusalem in ruins calls out to people walking past: is there any sorrow like mine?

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all _____ and supplication for all saints;
verse: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
note: The armour of God passage ends not with a weapon but with prayer — watching 'with all perseverance.'
